findings.description: The native-spacing projection makes ordinary Latin word groups readable across the two columns. The source retains frequent original hard-line hyphens and occasional internal spacing or glyph damage, including a stray bullet within a divided word on page 7; these remain source qualifications rather than new editorial corrections. Inline citations remain inline, and no source-note/body fusion is visible. Page 8 is sparse but contains the continuing final blessing, the Idibus Octobris 1890 dating clause, pontifical-year line and LEO PAPA XIII subscription before the ruled apparatus; it is a source-bearing final page.

documents.limitations: Visual layout, source-note separation and the explicitly bounded transformation invariants only. No original-print image collation, whole-book collation, independent translation-equivalence judgment, textual-completeness finding, or independent rights determination was performed. All pages were inspected on bounded contact sheets; full-resolution views are limited to the pages explicitly listed. No page-review reuse.

findings.description: Both pages are readable with clear column continuation and a compact final apparatus. Frequent source hard-line hyphens remain, together with isolated residual letterspacing such as h u m o and m o r u m on page 1. Those local source defects reduce reading comfort but do not make the body generally unreadable. Page 2 retains the continuing body, final blessing, 20 November 1890 dating clause and LEO PP. XIII subscription above the ruled source/rights notice. No historical citation note is fused into a body line.
